patterns: Decade swap, day 3: techhalla 'Street Fighter but it's 1977' 17K views / 593 likes / 109 bookmarks, then 'Metal Slug but it's 1971' 6.2K and a 'Magnific prompts below' follow-up 7K. Retro game/pop IP + era restyle + prompt hand-off keeps compounding.

Long-form AI film wins again: EHuanglu 'director Yiyi turned chinese myth into a 6 mins AI movie' 15.8K / 83 bookmarks, after his 'only short clips' 13.6K the day before. Story + duration is the hook.
New tool drops get reach: azed_ai 'Kling Image 4.0 is finally here' (character storyboards, consistent characters) 6.2K and 'Seedance 2.5 draft, upscaled with Topaz' 5.6K.
MAGI-2 cools inside the watchlist (maxescu animation learnings 1.9K, AIWarper benchmarks 3.4K) while sponsored outsider MAGI-2 posts reach 12-17K.
minchoi's two stars (humanoid robot teleop 17.7K, Grok deal hunting 16.3K) and EHuanglu 'claude doing motion graphics' 9.1K are tech/AI-agent news: off-niche for VFX.
